text: Completed P6 robust affine initialization. Added typed supplied and estimated AffineIso boundaries; center-of-mass plus deterministic rigid/affine physical search; clipped gain/offset-invariant bidirectional correlation with overlap admission; symmetric reconciliation of independently estimated directions; affine square-root midpoint split with structural swap/inverse equivariance; and typed diagnostics/failures. The native-grid accuracy-first refinement passes an independent analytic four-landmark RMS gate below 0.8 mm; the faster shrink-two variant was rejected at about 1.0 mm. Registration passes 32/32 JVM and 32/32 Scala.js; compileAll and full testAll pass. Canonical 32^3 JMH: 116.516 ms/op mean, 119.037 ms p95, 9,660,218.756 B/op, 3 collections/7 ms across 30 measurements. Receipt: docs/benchmarks/receipts/half-flow-affine-p6-2026-07-22.json. No Gale change: no general reusable Gale defect was found, and no registration-specific primitive was added. ANTs remains blocked on the unresponsive Docker Desktop daemon.
